thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-4721 — Elevated 502/504 errors observed in api-gateway (edge). 502 rate spike from ~12% to ~48% over last 5m. Severity: P1. Dashboard: https://ops.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-4721

maya: I'm oncall, pulling up dashboards and recent envoy logs now.

derek: I can join — seeing a burst of upstream timeouts from edge -> model-router (10.14.5.x). @maya do you want me to start a regional fallback?

maya: yes. first confirm if it's single AZ or region-wide. dashboards show spike across eu-1 AZs but concentrated on edge->model-router egress.

infra-oncall: scaling edge-proxy pool +2 nodes while we triage :gear:. K8s HPA already applied.

deploy-bot: Auto-scaling triggered: edge-proxy-eu replicas 6 -> 12. New pods expected ~45s.

jamie: quick check — logs show upstream connect_timeout and 504s, also some 502 from envoy returning HTTP/1.1 to clients.

derek: could be socket exhaustion or high SYN backlog. running netstat to confirm.

infra-oncall: ```kubectl exec -it edge-proxy-abcde -n prod -- sh -c "netstat -an | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l"```

infra-oncall: TIME_WAIT count high (~24k). Might be ephemeral port exhaustion from a noisy client or short keepalives.

maya: plan: 1) shift 15% traffic to eu-fallback region, 2) rolling restart model-router pods in eu-1, 3) keep scaling edge proxies and monitor. Derek, can you flip the routing weight?

derek: doing the gradual shift now. patching routing policy: ```kubectl patch trafficpolicy edge-routing -p '{"spec":{"weights":{"eu-1":85,"eu-fallback":15}}}' -n prod```

deploy-bot: Routing policy updated. eu-fallback weight = 15%.

olivia: support here — customer impact: external API 502 spike affecting EU customers, increased error budget burn on premium tenants. Drafting a status update.

maya: good. jamie/have we confirmed which endpoints are most impacted? logs point to /v1/generate and /v1/chat completions routed through model-router.

jamie: confirmed. top 5 affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings, /v1/retrieval, /v1/stream. ErrorRate by route attached in the dashboard.

derek: started rolling restart: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-router -n prod --selector=region=eu-1``` started at 1799990255.

maya: monitoring health checks. edge->model-router 5xx count dropping from 48% -> 18% after routing shift + restarts.

infra-oncall: netstat TIME_WAIT down to ~6k after connection reuse tweaks and kernel tunings. still watching socket pool.

jamie: errors now ~12% and latency 95th dropping. still above baseline but improving.

maya: I'll keep pager active until 15m of stable baseline. @olivia please post interim status page and escalate to account managers for affected customers.

olivia: Posted initial status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4721 — noted region, impact, mitigation in progress.

maya: suspected root cause: idle connection handling + envoy keepalive regression causing ephemeral port exhaustion. tagging eng-runtime to validate. @taylor can you take a look at envoy config and recent rolling deploys?

taylor: on it. grabbing envoy configs and recent releases. will validate if a proxy config change or upstream change pushed this over the limit.

deploy-bot: Config diff detected: envoy keepalive idle timeout lowered in last deploy 2h ago (envoy-config: keepalive_idle_ms 60000 -> 15000).

maya: that would explain faster churn of connections. taylor, can you propose a rollback or hotpatch?

taylor: recommending hotpatch to restore keepalive to 60s and bump per-worker socket limits. preparing PR.

infra-oncall: errors down to ~6% and trending to baseline. continuing to monitor for 10m.

maya: great work everyone. keeping channel open for postmortem. I'll leave the incident open until diagnostics complete and rollback deployed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVED — error rate returned to baseline (~1.2%) at 1799990360. Incident marked closed; postmortem required.

maya: filing postmortem ticket and scheduling follow-up with eng-runtime. thanks team. :thumbsup:
